_readme: Short text lines the game picks from at random. No AI needed. Each section has a _default list; add a list under a personality name to give that personality its own lines.
Placeholders: {name}, {house}, plus any extra ones noted for the section. Add as many lines as you like.
enc_* lines are short notes on how one client visit went for her (shown in the weekly report). job_* lines are report lines for the non-escort jobs.
encore: the line added when a restless lady goes another round. enc_frustrated / enc_drained / enc_like / enc_put_off: extra visit notes.
demo_lead / demo_watch: Sam's demonstration lesson ({name} = his partner). Templates; rewrite freely.

solo._note: Report line when a lady at max lust spends part of her night alone in her room instead. Shown in the weekly report.
_default: {name} disappeared to her room early one night and didn't come back down for a long while. She seemed a lot calmer afterward.
{name} locked her door for most of an evening. She came out flushed, relaxed, and tired.
Shy but earnest: {name} excused herself early one night, too embarrassed to say why. She avoided everyone's eyes at breakfast.
{name} spent an evening shut in her room with the curtains drawn. She insists she was reading.
Bookish and curious: {name} took a novel of the steamier sort up to her room and was not seen again that night.
{name} called it 'research' and locked her door. She came out with a very satisfied look and ink on her fingers.
Mysterious and aloof: {name} vanished one evening without explanation. When she returned, she was smiling to herself and offered none.
Proud and sharp-tongued: {name} decided she didn't need anyone's help with her problem, thank you, and took the evening to herself.
{name} snapped at two clients, then went to her room and slammed the door. An hour later she came out in a far better mood.
Laid-back and lazy: {name} figured the easiest solution was the one that didn't involve getting out of bed. She skipped most of one evening.
Calm and elegant: {name} retired early one evening for 'a long bath'. It was a very long bath.

modest._note: Shown on her sheet when she has the Modest trait.
_default: She'd rather keep her clothes on. When things get intimate, they get pulled aside instead, though the lewder she gets (and the more she trusts Sam), the more comes off.
{name} is still breathing hard, and she hasn't let go of him. "Again," she says. It isn't really a question.
{name} props herself up on one elbow and gives Sam a long, considering look. Apparently they're not finished.
{name}'s tail hasn't stopped moving. She nuzzles into Sam's neck, warm and insistent, and makes a small, needy sound that says she's nowhere near done.
{name} is up on her knees before Sam has caught his breath, ears forward, eyes bright. "More," she says, and climbs back into his lap.

late_visit._note: Opening line when a lady knocks on Sam's door late at night.
_default: Sam is doing the books by candlelight when {name} knocks. She hasn't seen a single client all week, and she's clearly been thinking about something. "Busy?"
{name} appears in Sam's doorway in her nightclothes, holding two cups of tea she clearly has no intention of drinking.
A note slides under Sam's door: "Still awake? Come find out." It's in {name}'s handwriting.
Shy but earnest: There's a very quiet knock. {name} is standing in the hall, red to the ears, and has clearly rehearsed what she wants to say. She forgets all of it.
Bold and flirtatious: {name} doesn't knock. She just leans in Sam's doorway until he notices her. "You work too hard, boss."

sleepin_evening._note: Opening line when the lady sharing Sam's bed in the Owner's Suite proposes as they turn in. Edit freely.
_default: The lamps are low in the Owner's Suite. {name} sits on the edge of the bed, unpinning her hair, and watches Sam over her shoulder. "We could just sleep," she says. "Or not."
{name} slides under the blanket and doesn't turn her back on him tonight. Her hand finds his. "Stay up a little longer," she murmurs.
"Long day," {name} says, curling against Sam's side in the dark. Her fingers start tracing slow circles on his chest. "I have a better idea than sleeping."

sleepin_morning._note: Opening line when the lady sharing Sam's bed wakes him in the morning with ideas of her own. Edit freely.
_default: Sam wakes to gray morning light and {name} propped on one elbow beside him, smiling like she's been awake a while. "Good morning," she says, and kisses him slowly.
Something warm presses against Sam's back, and {name}'s voice is a sleepy whisper at his ear. "Don't get up yet. I've got plans for you."
{name} has already pulled the covers over both their heads. "The house can wait," she says, "for a little while."

client_yes._note: Second half of a report highlight when a client got the service he asked for.
_default: They disappeared upstairs for most of the evening.
He came downstairs an hour later looking dazed and very satisfied.
The door stayed closed a long time. He tipped generously.
She came back down first, humming. He followed, red-faced and grinning.

client_company._note: Second half of a report highlight when a client only wanted her company.
_default: He left lighter in the purse and very happy about it.
He promised to come back next week.
He told three friends about her before he got home.

lover_waiting._note: Opening line when a lover (Devoted) at max lust comes to Sam instead of handling it herself.
_default: {name} is sitting on the edge of Sam's bed when he gets back, shoes off, very much not reading the book in her lap. "You've been busy all week," she says. "I've been patient."
Sam finds a note on his desk in {name}'s handwriting: "My room. Tonight. Don't make me come get you."
Shy but earnest: {name} hovers in Sam's doorway, fidgeting with her sleeve. "I, um. I waited. For you. All week." She's bright red.
Proud and sharp-tongued: {name} corners Sam in the hall. "I don't beg," she says. "So you're going to notice on your own that it's been a week."

lover_reunion._note: First line of the scene when Sam goes to a lover who's been waiting.
_default: She pulls him in by the collar and doesn't let go for a long time.
"Finally," she breathes, and the door clicks shut behind them.

good_night._note: Report line after a week where her clients loved her.
_default: {name} had a great week and knows it. She's in a very good mood.
Cheerful and teasing: {name} spent breakfast bragging about her week to anyone who'd listen, with impressions of her clients.
Shy but earnest: {name} didn't say much, but she kept smiling to herself all week. Someone said she did well and she turned bright red.
Proud and sharp-tongued: {name} reminded everyone, twice, that she is the best in the house. Nobody argued.
Hot-blooded and competitive: {name} has started keeping a tally of satisfied clients on the kitchen wall. She's winning.
Bookish and curious: {name} has notes on what worked this week. Detailed notes. She'd like to discuss them.
Warm and motherly: {name}'s clients left happy, and she made a point of making sure the other girls did too.
Mysterious and aloof: {name} said nothing about her week. Her clients said plenty.
Laid-back and lazy: {name} had a good week with surprisingly little effort, which she considers the ideal week.

bad_night._note: Report line after a rough week with unhappy or difficult clients.
_default: {name} had a rough week. A couple of clients left unhappy, and so did she.
Shy but earnest: {name} had a bad client this week and has been very quiet since. She keeps apologizing for nothing.
Proud and sharp-tongued: Two of {name}'s clients complained. {name} complained louder, and is now refusing to speak to anyone.
Hot-blooded and competitive: {name} took a bad week personally. She's been training twice as hard out of spite.
Cheerful and teasing: {name} laughed off a bad client, but the jokes have been a little thinner this week.
Laid-back and lazy: {name} had a bad week and shrugged it off. Mostly.
Mysterious and aloof: Something about this week bothered {name}. She won't say what.

lover_jealous._note: When one of Sam's lovers has been left out for weeks while another hasn't. {other} = the other lover.
_default: {name} has noticed exactly how many evenings Sam has spent with {other} lately, and exactly how many he's spent with her. She'd like to talk.
Shy but earnest: {name} hasn't said anything. She's just been very quiet whenever {other} is around, and Sam finally notices.
Proud and sharp-tongued: "I'm not jealous," {name} announces, apropos of nothing, while glaring at {other} across the room.
Hot-blooded and competitive: {name} has started treating {other} like a rival. Breakfast has become very tense.

lover_shared._note: When two happy lovers come to Sam's room together. {other} = the second lover.
_default: There's a knock at Sam's door. It's {name}. Then a second knock: {other}, right behind her. They look at each other, then at Sam, and seem to reach an understanding without him.

breakup._note: When Sam ends things with a lover. She stays on at the house.
_default: {name} listens without interrupting. "Okay," she says finally. "I'll be fine. Just... give me some time."
Shy but earnest: {name} nods too fast and says she understands, then excuses herself. Nobody sees her for the rest of the day.
Proud and sharp-tongued: "Fine," {name} says crisply. "Your loss." She makes it all the way to the hallway before her voice cracks.
Warm and motherly: {name} squeezes his hand. "You're allowed to change your mind, love. I'm not going anywhere." She cries later, alone.
Hot-blooded and competitive: {name} throws a cup at the wall. Then she apologizes to the cup. Then she leaves.
Laid-back and lazy: {name} shrugs a little too casually. "Sure. Whatever works." She doesn't come down for dinner.
Mysterious and aloof: {name} says nothing at all. She just looks at him for a long moment, then nods once and goes.

rekindle_yes._note: When an ex-lover agrees to try again.
_default: {name} pretends to think about it for exactly three seconds. "Took you long enough."

rekindle_no._note: When an ex-lover isn't ready to try again.
_default: {name} smiles, a little sadly. "Not yet. Ask me again sometime."
She enjoyed that one.
Her favorite. She was humming afterward.
She came back downstairs smiling.

enc_dislike._note: Client asked for something she dislikes but does.
_default: Not her favorite.
She got through it, but it's not her thing.
She was a little quiet afterward.

enc_stretch._note: A service that's still a stretch for her with clients.
_default: A stretch for her. She did it anyway.
She wasn't sure about it, and it showed a little.
Outside her comfort zone, but she managed.

enc_eager._note: She was in the mood (high lust).
_default: She'd been wanting it all week.
She was more into it than he was.
She was very much in the mood.
He left glowing.
He's already asking when she's free next.
He tipped well and said so twice.
He left grumbling.
It didn't really click.
Neither of them enjoyed it much.
She didn't mind saying no.
No hard feelings either way.

enc_nomood._note: She turned it down because she wasn't in the mood (low lust).
_default: She just wasn't in the mood.
Not tonight, she said.

job_bartender._note: Weekly report line for a bartender.
_default: {name} kept the drinks flowing at {house} and settled two arguments with a single raised eyebrow.
{name} invented a new cocktail this week. Half the regulars love it, the other half are scared of it.
{name} worked the bar all week and knows every regular's order by heart now.

job_dancer._note: Weekly report line for a dancer.
_default: {name}'s new routine had the lounge on its feet.
{name} danced every night this week. Someone threw flowers, which she pretended not to love.
A crowd gathered early for {name}'s set. The bar did well out of it.

job_bath._note: Weekly report line for a bath attendant.
_default: {name} kept the baths hot and the guests relaxed.
{name} has the guests so relaxed they forget to leave. She considers it a professional achievement.
Steam, scented oil, and {name}'s soft humming. The bathhouse was busy all week.

job_bath_joined._note: Bath attendant comfortable enough to join bathers in the water (bath massage).
_default: {name} didn't just tend the baths this week; she got in. Bath massages, in the water, became the most requested thing on the menu.
{name} spent most of the week in the hot water with the guests, working out knots. Nobody wanted to leave the pool.
Steam, scented oil, and {name} slipping into the water to give massages where they soak. Business was very good.

job_bath_more._note: Bath attendant who joined bathers and, in the mood, offered them more.
_default: {name} joined the bathers in the water, and once or twice the massage turned into something more, at her suggestion.
Bath massages in the water all week, and {name} was in such a mood that a few lucky guests got more than their backs worked on.
The baths were busy and so was {name}. When the mood took her, the massages didn't stay massages.

job_teacher._note: Weekly report line for the classroom teacher.
_default: {name} ran the classroom at {house} with a ruler and endless patience. Notes were taken.
{name} drilled the house until the lesson stuck. Somebody asked for homework. {name} was delighted.
{name} wrote on the slate, pointed, and waited. By evening the whole house was practising.

job_maid._note: Weekly report line for a maid.
_default: {name} scrubbed {house} until it shone. Guests noticed.
{name} found three lost earrings, a sword, and a love letter while cleaning. She returned all of them.
{name} reorganized the linen closet. Nobody asked her to. Everybody's grateful.
{name} walked a drunk adventurer to the door without him even noticing he'd been thrown out.
A quiet week on watch for {name}. She suspects her reputation is doing half the work.
{name} stood by the door looking unimpressed all week. It worked.

job_madame._note: Weekly report line for a madame.
_default: {name} ran {house} like clockwork and kept everyone's schedules sane.
{name} smoothed over two complaints and a near-duel. Business as usual.
{name} checked in on every lady at least once this week. They noticed.

job_rest._note: Weekly report line for a lady resting.
_default: {name} took the week off: long baths, long naps, and a book she's been meaning to finish.
{name} slept in every day this week and regrets nothing.
{name} spent her week off wandering the market and came back with snacks for everyone.

job_rest_demon._note: Weekly report line for a resting demon. Demons don't recover from sleep: on a week off they slip out and feed on men in town.
_default: {name} took the week off, which for a demon means slipping out after dark and feeding on whichever men in town looked at her twice. She came back glowing.
{name} spent her week off in the taverns across town, sipping on strangers. Nobody she fed on remembers her name, which is the point.
{name} rested the demon way: a different tavern every night, a different admirer, and back home by dawn, much less hungry.

private_act._note: A line for the service itself, after an encounter's or a first's own opening. Keyed by service id (services.json).
caress: It stays slow and unhurried: long kisses, wandering hands, and neither of them in any hurry to stop.
They lose an hour to kissing like teenagers and don't regret a minute of it.
manual_give: Her hands are clever and very sure of themselves. Sam's are learning fast.
She keeps her eyes on his face the whole time, enjoying every reaction.
oral_give: She takes her time with him, plainly enjoying how quickly he loses the ability to form sentences.
Sam ends up staring at the ceiling, trying to remember his own name.
breast_give: She has an idea, and is extremely pleased with herself about it. Sam is in no position to argue.
She's smug about it afterward. She's earned it.
missionary: Afterward they lie tangled together, her head on his chest, listening to the house go quiet.
It's tender and a little clumsy and exactly right.
cowgirl: She takes charge from the first minute and keeps it, and looks thoroughly smug about it afterward.
She sets the pace. Sam is very happy to let her.
doggy: The bed creaks, the headboard knocks, and somebody next door bangs on the wall. Neither of them stops.
By the end she's laughing into the pillow and Sam can't feel his legs.

sam_first._note: Added when a lady is Sam's first, past kissing.
_default: It becomes clear about four seconds in that Sam's previous-life experience in this department is exactly zero. {name} looks absolutely delighted about this.
Somewhere in the middle of it, Sam realizes this is his first time in two lives. {name} realizes it too, and is very, very kind about it.

enc_frustrated._note: A finishing service that left her wanting more.
_default: It left her a little frustrated.
She wanted more than he knew how to give.
Not quite what she was hoping for.

enc_drained._note: A restless demon fed too eagerly.
_default: He left pale and shaky.
He had to sit down for a while afterward.
He stumbled out looking decidedly drained.

rest_demon_drain._note: A restless demon overdid it feeding in town on her week off (town reputation loss).
_default: A dockhand she fed on had to be carried home. People are talking.
One of her admirers in town fainted in the street. Word got around about where she works.
She left a guardsman too dizzy to stand. That will be told around town for weeks.

enc_like._note: Client who's a fan of her kind.
_default: He admitted he'd been hoping for her specifically.
He was a fan from the moment he saw her.

enc_put_off._note: Client who's uneasy around her kind.
_default: He seemed ill at ease around her.
He kept glancing away. It wasn't her best night.

encore._note: She wasn't done after the first round.
_default: ...and she wasn't done with him yet.

job_promoter._note: Weekly report line for a promoter (no samples).
_default: {name} stood at the door of {house} all week, handing out flyers and smiling at everyone who slowed down.
{name} struck up conversations with half the street. A few of them even came inside.
{name} learned which tavern crowds are worth chatting up and which are just looking for a free drink.

job_promoter_samples._note: Weekly report line for a promoter handing out free samples.
_default: {name} handed out little teasers all week and left a trail of curious faces in her wake.
{name} gave away a lot of smiles and a few sample tastes. The queue at {house} grew.
{name} made the free samples sound irresistible. They were not wrong.

job_attendant._note: Weekly report line for an attendant.
_default: {name} kept the corridors of {house} moving: towels, wine, and a calm word when it was needed.
{name} spent the week making the courtesans' evenings easier. Nobody had to ask twice.
{name} refilled glasses, fetched shawls, and noticed everything.

job_host._note: Weekly report line for a host.
_default: {name} kept the lounge of {house} lively: stories, refilled glasses, and a warm smile for everyone waiting.
{name} made sure nobody waited alone at {house}. Conversation came easily to her.
{name} spent the week charming the guests in the lounge, one more round and one more story at a time.

job_courtesan._note: Weekly report line for a courtesan who had no clients.
_default: A quiet week for {name}. She wrote letters and rearranged her room twice.
{name} waited in the lounge all week. The clients simply did not come.

job_samples_rep_good._note: Note when a promoter's samples raised the house's name.
_default: {name}'s samples had the whole district talking about {house}.

job_samples_rep_bad._note: Note when a promoter's samples cheapened the house.
_default: {name}'s samples left people shrugging. {house} looked a little cheaper for it.

stepped_in._note: Note when a madame or attendant took clients because the courtesans were swamped ({clients} = 'one client' / 'N clients', {did} = ' (kiss ×2, massage)' or ' (company only)').
_default: {name} stepped in for {clients} when the courtesans were swamped{did}.
{name} took the overflow herself: {clients}{did}, so nobody had to be turned away.

pushy_talked._note: A client got pushy and she talked him down herself. Non-graphic.
_default: A client got pushy with {name}, but she kept her head and talked him down before it went any further.
Someone wouldn't take no from {name}. A calm word and a steady look, and he backed off.

pushy_security._note: A client got pushy and security handled it. Non-graphic.
_default: A client got pushy with {name}, and security walked him out.
Someone wouldn't take no from {name}. Security walked him out before it went further.

pushy_sam._note: A client got pushy and Sam stepped in. Non-graphic.
_default: A client got pushy with {name}. Sam stepped in and settled it.
A client wouldn't take no for an answer. Sam stepped in and walked him to the door.

pushy_samfail._note: A client got pushy and Sam's attempt went badly. Non-graphic.
_default: A client got pushy with {name}. Sam stepped in, and it went badly: a loud scene, a bruised ego, and a bad story about {house}.

pushy_samcall._note: A client got pushy, security could not handle it, and Sam was sent for (resolved by the player after the report). Non-graphic.
_default: A client got pushy with {name}. Security couldn't handle him, and someone ran to fetch Sam.

pushy_none._note: A client got pushy and nobody was there. Non-graphic.
_default: A client got pushy with {name} and nobody was around to help. She got away from him, shaken.
{name} had to talk her way out of a client who wouldn't take no. Nobody was near.
He got pushy; she talked him down.
He got pushy; security walked him out.
He got pushy; Sam stepped in.
He got pushy; Sam's intervention went badly.
He got pushy and nobody was there to help.
He got pushy; security sent for Sam.

self_prop._note: A restless lady propositioned a client herself.
_default: {name}, restless, picked out a client herself and he was not about to say no.
{name} caught a client's eye across the lounge and made the first move.

rooms_short._note: Note: the house ran out of room sessions.
_default: {house} ran short on rooms this week. More bedrooms would have meant more clients.

tidy_high._note: Weekly note when the house is spotless.
_default: {house} is spotless, and everyone seems to breathe easier for it.

tidy_low._note: Weekly note when the house is getting shabby.
_default: {house} is getting untidy. Guests have noticed, and so have the ladies.

tidy_bad._note: Weekly note when the house is a mess.
_default: {house} is a mess. Guests wrinkle their noses and the ladies are miserable.

expect_miss._note: A client expected the attendant to offer, and she didn't.
_default: A client seemed to expect {name} to make an offer. She didn't, and he left a little sour.

prop_accept_reluctant._note: She accepted a proposition without much enthusiasm.
_default: {name} said yes to a proposition she wasn't really in the mood for.

bath_massage._note: Weekly line for a bath attendant who gave massages.
_default: {name} offered every bather a massage, and most of them said yes.

enc_noroom._note: No free room for the client.
_default: No room was free, so he went home disappointed.

enc_expect._note: A client expected the attendant to make an offer.
_default: He seemed to expect an offer and left a little sour.

beauty: Sam books {name} an afternoon with a stylist he can't quite afford, then sits in the corner taking notes on skincare.
{name} and Sam go through posture, grooming and how to stand in good light. Sam holds the mirror.
charm: Sam plays a string of difficult guests for {name} to win over. His grumpy dwarf impression is a highlight.
{name} practices small talk on Sam until he forgets it's practice.
charisma: Sam has {name} address an empty common room as if it were packed, then again, louder, from the stairs.
{name} rehearses toasts and introductions while Sam heckles gently from the back.
refinement: Sam and {name} work through table settings, forms of address and which fork is for what. Neither of them is sure about the fish fork.
{name} reads poetry aloud while Sam corrects her pronunciation from a borrowed etiquette book.
wits: Sam sets {name} logic puzzles from a book he half remembers from his old world. She solves the last one faster than he can.
{name} and Sam spend the afternoon on riddles, ledgers and a board game Sam had someone carve for him.
stamina: Sam takes {name} on a long run along the river. He regrets it before she does.
{name} works through a circuit Sam drew up: stairs, buckets of water, more stairs.
strength: {name} hauls crates in the storeroom while Sam counts reps and pretends he could lift them too.
Sam borrows weights from the guild and spots {name} through an afternoon of lifting.
agility: Sam chalks a pattern on the courtyard floor and has {name} dance, dodge and step through it until it's second nature.
{name} practices balance on the garden wall while Sam hovers underneath, ready to catch her.

sample_act._note: Report highlight for one free sample a promoter gave on the street ({act} = the service, {lady} = 'offered a massage' style phrase).
_default: {name} pulled a curious passer-by into a doorway near {house} and {lady}, free of charge, then pressed a card into his hand.
Out on the street, {name} gave one hesitant man a free sample: she {lady}, then pointed him at {house}'s door.
{name}'s free sample of the week: a quick {act} in the shadow of {house}'s lanterns. He was inside within the hour.

step_lead._note: Opening of a report highlight when a madame or attendant served a client because the courtesans were swamped ({role} = 'the madame' / 'an attendant').
_default: Every courtesan was busy, so {name} stepped in herself.
With the courtesans swamped, {name} set aside her duties as {role} for a client.
No courtesan was free, and {name} didn't want anyone turned away.

act_turn._note: Shown right after an encounter's or a first's opening (before the service line and any AI text), so the story says which way the moment went. Keyed by service id. Edit freely; {name} = her name.
massage_give: Somewhere between kisses {name} pushes him gently down onto the bed and says he's far too tense. Her hands go to his shoulders: a massage, and a good one.
{name} breaks off with a laugh, turns him around by the shoulders and starts working the knots out of his back instead.
massage_get: {name} stretches, winces at her own shoulders, and asks if he'd mind. He doesn't mind. He gives her a massage, slowly, and she melts into it.
She rolls onto her front and asks him for a massage. Sam takes the job very seriously.
manual_get: She guides his hand where she wants it and keeps hers over it, showing him.
{name} takes his hand and lets him know, without a word, that she wants to be touched.
manual_give: Her hand slips lower, and {name} smiles at the face he makes.
{name} decides it's her turn to take care of him, and her hands go to work.
breast_get: {name} undoes her top and lets him explore, watching his face the whole time.
She guides his hands to her chest and lets him take his time.
oral_get: {name} lies back and, a little shyly, asks him to use his mouth on her. He does.
She pushes him down gently, and her meaning is very clear.
oral_give: {name} slides down to her knees with a look that says she's been planning this.
She kisses her way down his chest and doesn't stop.
breast_give: {name} has an idea, and the way she unbuttons her top says she's proud of it.
She pulls her top off and shows him exactly what she has in mind.
missionary: They end up in bed, her pulling him down on top of her.
She lies back and pulls him with her, and that's that.
cowgirl: {name} pushes him back onto the bed and climbs on top.
She straddles him and takes charge.
doggy: {name} turns over onto her hands and knees and looks back at him over her shoulder.
She rolls onto her front and looks back at him with a grin.

_default: Sam claps his hands for attention and announces a practical lesson. {name} stands up before he can ask, already untying something. "Pay attention, everyone," she says. "He gets nervous when nobody takes notes."

The parlor is full, the cushions are claimed, and {name} is in the middle of it all with Sam, explaining each step as they go like it's the most normal thing in the world. Sam's ears are bright red. Nobody looks away.
{name} volunteers so fast that a couple of the others laugh. She takes Sam's hand, turns to the room, and says, "Right. Watch closely, this is the part everyone gets wrong."
By the end, the room is very quiet and very warm. Several of the ladies have taken notes. Some of them are fanning themselves with the notes.
Afterward nobody quite meets anybody's eyes, and everyone has questions. A lot of questions.
There's scattered applause. Someone asks if there'll be a follow-up class. Several people ask, actually.
